name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: A shimmer placeholder that crossfades to the real content once it has loaded.
useWhen: Showing a loading state resolving to real content: the skeleton fades out as the real UI fades in.
Demonstrating content that loads in as a crossfade moment.
You need a full skeleton layout (lines or card) wrapping real content.
avoidWhen: You only need a single shimmer rectangle: use skeleton-block.
Content has no loading state: render it directly.
You need a spinner-style loading indicator: use spinner.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Layout
variables.description: Placeholder shape: a profile card, or three lines of text.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
